profile.headline: Sr. Web Developer at Backyard Studios
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with multidisciplinary experience in Marketing, Sales, Customer Service, Account and Business Management, Project and Team Management, Training, and Public Speaking.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas, United States · On-site
positions.description: As Senior Web Developer and team lead at Backyard Studios, I help steer the technical side of a fast-moving, WordPress-driven creative agency. I lead a sharp, agile team of developers, overseeing everything from project strategy and scalable architecture to clean, custom code that performs in the real world—not just on staging sites. I've built reusable frameworks, streamlined our workflows, and greatly cut down project delivery times, all while maintaining high standards for UX, SEO, design, and modern web performance. I thrive at the intersection of leadership and hands-on problem solving—mentoring developers, collaborating cross-functionally, and keeping clients happy with sites that look beautiful, load fast, and work flawlessly. Just as importantly, I’ve built a reputation for maintaining and fostering deep client relationships through clear communication, trust, and a relentless focus on delivering real value. Whether it’s integrating complex APIs, optimizing performance, or quietly fixing the thing no one else caught, I’m proud to help keep Backyard Studios running smoothly, smartly, and just a bit ahead of the curve.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · PHP · E-Commerce · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Project Management · Team Leadership · Customer Retention · NetSuite · Shopify · Managed Hosting · Email Deliverability · Software Project Management · Custom Software Development

positions.title: CEO
positions.description: We are a team of digital architects and specialists that helps businesses scale with the right technology to drive more traffic & convert leads. We specialize in digital marketing, cybersecurity & data migration, as well as e-commerce setup via payment processing and payment load balancing.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Demonstrated complete understanding of WordPress websites including design and development.
    Worked with HTML and CSS.
    Worked with PHP, MySQL, Javascript.
    Worked with multiple system integrations (Zapier, Salesforce/JSON, and other various 3rd party systems)
    Upload website instances into hosting platforms.
    Manage WordPress, Shopify, Wix, and Webflow hosting process and procedures.
    Demonstrated working knowledge of PHP, MySQL, Javascript.
    Integration specialist, knowledge of integrating widgets, RSS feeds, database exports/imports and plugins.
    Demonstrated a keen eye for design and website functionality.
    Demonstrated Back-end (full-stack) development.
    Demonstrated App (iOS/Android) development.

positions.title: Senior Account Manager
positions.description:
Stash Media Group helps deliver highly effective marketing solutions for a digital world. We specialize in digital marketing services, such as social media marketing, content creation, search engine optimization, search engine marketing, web analytics, web design and mobile applications development.

Specialties
Brand Management, Social Media Marketing, Marketing, Web Development, Graphic Design, Business Develoment, Print Production, App Development.

http://www.stashmediagroup.com/

positions.title: Art Direction
positions.description: Responsible for designing, building, and maintaining web pages and web applications to support the organization's strategic goals; overseeing the development, maintenance, and operation of large-scale, multi-page, and interactive River Authority websites.

positions.description:
Brand development.

Strategic Consulting, including business plan & sales strategy development.

Market Research/Penetration.

Drop-n-Drink Through Blast Cap Technology.

BLAST Alcoholic Flavoring.

positions.title: Assistant Photographer / Videographer
positions.description: Having worked with Limelight San Antonio before it became an official company, I have had the pleasure of attending many events and special club nights as the primary photographer, ultimately assisting as videographer for various weddings/events, as well as assisting other photographers during many on-location sessions as well.

positions.title: Contract Developer
positions.description: I was contracted with Andrade to handle the development and launch for Power Financial Credit Union (PowerFi). This project was completed in November 2014.

positions.title: Responsive Manager
positions.description:
Starting as a Web Developer - Specializing in E-Commerce development, HTML5 Motion Graphics/Development, Expression Engine development, and light Graphic Design work.. Utilizing jQuery, CSS3, PHP, SEO, PPC, SEM, and various other web technologies.

Transitioned from Support Administrator, utilizing Sales, Customer Service, Project Management, Employee Training; to Responsive development Manager. 

Jack of all trades.

positions.title: Web Designer & Web Developer
positions.description: While working with CityWide SEO (a division of Boss Creative), I also created numerous templates (from scratch), that were used for various SEO-based clients. My previous responsibilities at Boss Creative were extended to this position as well.

positions.title: Web Designer / Web Developer
positions.description: GVO contracted me for 3 months to lead the company’s initiative in marketing and advertising via a new campaign that included both print and digital materials.

positions.title: Director of Development
positions.description: As Director of Development, I lead the development team in deployment/execution of various marketing platforms and their functionality.

positions.title: Web Developer / Designer
positions.description: As a web developer for Boss Creative, I utilized Flash Actionscript 2 and 3, Motion graphics, design, and development (both front and backend) skills. Drupal was the CMS of choice here, and developing custom drupal plugins was necessary.

company.name: Boss Creative / Marketing Strategies | Web Design San Antonio

positions.title: Senior Flash Developer
positions.description: As the Senior Flash Developer at Anderson Marketing Group, I worked closely with my Supervisor, the Account Executives and our clients directly, to ensure the best project scope, not just for Flash-based development; but all incoming projects as well. My role involved not only various levels of backend development (PHP / jQuery), but front-end, Flash, as well as Sharepoint/C#/ASP/.NET, and iPhone / Mobile Development.

positions.title: Flash / Web Developer
positions.description: Working with a company as creative and as strong as Blue Clover was an amazing Experience. I was contracted through Robert Half Technology as the Web Developer for Blue Clover. My role involved minor backend development (such as Joomla / PHP / Java development) and a majority focused on Flash Development (AS 3, XML, AS 2) as well as full front-end development ( CSS / XHTML Strict ).

positions.title: UI Design Specialist
positions.description: BroadRamp specializes in the ability to compress large video (of GBs in size) to smaller file sizes (MBs) to be viewed on the web via broadband connection; utilizing what is called Managed Content Delivery System, or MCDS. As a multimedia/flash developer, it is my task to take a project/contract from the initial phase of planning and research, to see it through it’s release. From concepts and sketches, to designing in Photoshop, to taking the UI elements into flash/flash as2&3 /after effects, and ultimately to code in css/html/asp; I am able to almost completely control the product at hand for a specific client, much like a Creative Director or Project Manager. My ending title of UI Design Specialist was granted to me as I went from strictly Flash Development to becoming the company’s only UI Design Specialist; that of which serves as a liaison between the development team and the design team. This is much like the role of Project Manager as well; and requires knowledge in both design and development aspects in order to successfully and accurately represent the project and it’s entirety when ultimately releasing the “final version” that has everything placed together for the final “application” or website.

positions.title: Account Executive
positions.description: As account executive at Washington mutual, I was responsible for maintaining a customer relationship and pipeline with customers over the phone while establishing new accounts and services with the customer. I also was responsible for recommending various products/services depending on income situation and/or financial situation.

projects.title: Alamo Exteriors Website
projects.description: Alamo Exteriors was referred to me by the owner of Digett, a website design and development services in San Antonio Texas. He had fallen off the search engines after the Panda Update, and has not been able to recover. Mr. Joe Jackson and I designed, developed, and implemented a new website for Alamo Exteriors in 8 weeks. I will now begin applying additional SEO practices to his now optimized and original website as well as building his online reputation through social media management services.

projects.title: Talya's Sponsorship Site
projects.description: A connection to a paypal account that was created to help sponsors more easily donate funds into Talya's account to assist in earning the money to get her to New York for a introduction to a prestigious modeling and talent scout organization.
